manifest.label: 胡桃喵 · 完整模型适配

retarget.method: Japanese PMX bone semantics and source joint positions map limbs to p0 BNC; continuous native-height torso weights avoid short PMX joint spacing shear. Original AMB drives 30 bones.
retarget.fingerArticulation: PMX fingers follow native hands; no full MMD finger/morph/IK simulation

provenance.source: User-provided complete 胡桃喵1.0.pmx; source files read-only; no third-party plugin executed.
provenance.modelAdaptedBy: 观海 (PMX embedded readme); 摸鱼大水怪 (user folder attribution)
provenance.face: Complete authored PMX face, mouth, teeth, lashes, eyebrows and eyes retained; no face parts extracted into another model.
provenance.textures: Five original 2048x2048 PNG color maps, original PMX UVs retained; incompatible earlier 4K GIMI maps are not mixed.
provenance.license: Embedded model instructions: noncommercial, no redistribution or extraction of parts for other models. Conversion retained locally.
limits: No MMD/Genshin hair, cloth or rigid-body physics
No MMD facial morph or finger simulation
MMD additive sphere-map pass represented by normal Web material specular, not a duplicate mesh

omittedRenderPasses.reason: MMD additive sphere/specular overlay duplicates hair triangles; Web PBR uses one surface.
